onboarding.intro.hero.subtitle: Let people and AI work in the same context
onboarding.intro.hero.title: Octo is built for human-AI collaboration
onboarding.intro.meanings.context.descri: Knowledge belongs to clear context, with traceable sources and accountability.
onboarding.intro.meanings.context.title: Context
onboarding.intro.meanings.open.descripti: Your data works for you. It is not collected into a pool; it only serves your workflow.
onboarding.intro.meanings.open.title: Open
People and AI coordinate work in the same shared context.
onboarding.intro.meanings.taste.descript: Human judgment and tradeoffs stay protected, so preference is not averaged away.
onboarding.intro.meanings.taste.title: Taste
onboarding.sections.aiAvatar.description: Create a workplace AI avatar for yourself, so it can join collaboration with your context, standards, and working style.
onboarding.sections.aiAvatar.label: AI avatar
onboarding.sections.aiAvatar.previewHint: It will appear in @ mentions with your working context.
onboarding.sections.aiAvatar.title: Create your AI avatar
onboarding.sections.browserExtension.des: Use the Octo browser extension to bring useful pages, documents, and customer materials back into team context instead of leaving them scattered across personal browsers.
onboarding.sections.favorites.descriptio: Group chats, subspaces, and AI agents can all be followed. Important customers, long-running projects, and active tasks will not be washed away by the message stream, and you can return to key work from Favorites.
onboarding.sections.favorites.label: Favorites
onboarding.sections.favorites.title: Keep key work in Favorites
onboarding.sections.groupMd.description: GROUP.md is the long-term handbook for a group. Goals, resource links, collaboration rules, and instructions for AI agents can all live there, so new members and AI can first understand how the group works.
onboarding.sections.groupMd.title: Set rules in GROUP.md
onboarding.sections.smartSummary.descrip: When discussions get long and information becomes scattered, AI Summary reorganizes key conclusions, disagreements, open questions, and next actions. It does not decide for you; it helps people return to the judgment context faster.
onboarding.sections.smartSummary.label: AI Summary
onboarding.sections.smartSummary.title: Clarify context with AI Summary
onboarding.sections.subspaces.descriptio: When a group discussion grows, create a subspace for a project, customer, or task. Related messages, materials, judgments, and next actions gather in one place, so the team does not repeatedly search through the message stream for context.
onboarding.sections.subspaces.label: Subspaces
onboarding.sections.subspaces.title: Move tasks into subspaces
onboarding.sections.webhook.description: CI notices, alerts, GitHub events, and customer-system messages can enter the relevant group chat through Webhook. The team can see them, AI agents can see them, and external events become part of the collaboration context.
onboarding.sections.webhook.title: Route events into context
onboarding.sections.workspace.descriptio: Octo keeps familiar direct messages and group chats, while turning long-running work into sustainable context. Group chats handle daily communication, subspaces carry projects and tasks, GROUP.md records team rules, and AI agents help organize, analyze, and move work forward in that context.
onboarding.sections.workspace.label: Workspace
onboarding.sections.workspace.title: How Octo organizes work
